desc:
⭐ Welcome to Keyboard Slide +1 Speed! ⭐

👟 Train your speed on colorful keyboards
⚡ Slide across the keyboards and travel as far as possible.
🏆 Earn Trophies based on the distance you travel
🧪 Buy powerful Glide Juices to slide even faster
🌈 Collect unique Trails and Auras to customize your style
🌎 Discover amazing keyboard themes and become the best slider!

🔥 Challenge your friends and other players.
👑 Become the FASTEST player in the server!
💥 Every point of speed counts... the faster you are, the farther you will go!

🎵 Relaxing ASMR Experience
Enjoy satisfying keyboard sounds, smooth sliding, colorful visuals, and a relaxing atmosphere while trying to beat your next distance record!
